description: SERP history for one tracked keyword — which apps ranked in the top results on each measured day, newest first. Use this to see who competes on a keyword and how the top spots shifted over time. The keyword must be tracked in the caller's Sonar workspace. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts).

keyword_id.description: Sonar keyword UUID — a `keyword_id` from sonar_app_keywords or sonar_competitor_keywords. NOT the keyword text.

name: sonar_keyword_rankings
title: Keyword SERP History
